properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-1/SHA-2 hash implementations available in the shipped hash.js library, reached through the legacy ethers@4.0.49 copy in the dependency tree. No application call site found — the app itself uses ethers v5 APIs; presence-only item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 implementation available in the shipped crypto-js@3.3.0 (transitive, eth-lightwallet@3.0.1 chain); MD5 is collision-broken — kept in the inventory for the dependency CBOM. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 implementation available in the shipped crypto-js@3.3.0 (transitive, eth-lightwallet@3.0.1 chain); SHA-1 is collision-broken. No application call site found — presence-only item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is this dApp's fundamental signature curve — Ethereum wallets and transactions sign ECDSA on secp256k1 (live app sites: src/components/Demo.tsx signMessage, hardhat.config.ts deployer key, contracts/ITManToken.sol ERC20Permit). The lockfile sites are dependency records that ship ECDSA-secp256k1 implementations with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak/SHA-3 ships with the build and is also Ethereum's on-chain hashing standard (EIP-712 domain hashing in contracts/ITManToken.sol, keccak256 slots in ERC-1967 proxies). Quantum-safe per catalogue (Grover only). Presence-only dependency item for app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 KDF ships with the build; ethers v5 uses it to derive keys for Ethereum JSON-V3 keystore encryption (scrypt alternative per the EIP-2335 keystore profile). No first-party keystore call site in app code — presence-only item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js provides the scrypt memory-hard KDF; ethers uses scrypt (N=131072) to encrypt Ethereum JSON keystores. Available in the shipped library; no application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1/SHA-2 streaming implementations ship with the build through the Node-crypto polyfill chain; available in the shipped library; no application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@3.1.0 ships ECDSA/ECDH on secp256k1 and other curves; it is a 2014-era release — notable as an ancient crypto dependency, reachable only through the optional legacy chain. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2/MD5/keccak implementations; available in the shipped library via legacy ethers@4.0.49; no application call site found — presence-only item.
